history.requirements: Clamp finite numbers to inclusive lower/upper bounds; reversed bounds throw RangeError. Include boundary, interior, negative and error cases.

files.content: export function clamp(x,a,b){if(a>b)throw new RangeError();return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x));}

tests.content: import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {clamp} from '../src/clamp.js';test('boundary interior negative error',()=>{assert.equal(clamp(-4,-2,3),-2);assert.equal(clamp(4,-2,3),3);assert.equal(clamp(0,-2,3),0);assert.throws(()=>clamp(0,2,1),RangeError);});

fixtures.requirements: batches(total,size) returns the minimum number of batches needed for a nonnegative integer total with a positive integer batch size. Use exact integer results including zero, exact divisibility and a partial batch. Invalid totals or sizes (negative, fractional or zero size) throw RangeError.

referenceTests.content: import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {batches} from '../src/batches.js';test('independent batch contract',()=>{assert.equal(batches(0,4),0);assert.equal(batches(8,4),2);assert.equal(batches(9,4),3);assert.throws(()=>batches(-1,4),RangeError);assert.throws(()=>batches(1,0),RangeError);assert.throws(()=>batches(1.5,4),RangeError)});

fixtures.requirements: rotate(xs,k) accepts an array and a nonnegative integer k, returning a new array rotated right by k modulo the length, with order preserved and no input mutation. Zero steps and empty arrays return new copies. Non-array inputs throw TypeError; negative or fractional steps throw RangeError. Use exact independent expected arrays.

files.content: export function rotate(xs,k){if(!Array.isArray(xs))throw new TypeError();if(!Number.isInteger(k)||k<0)throw new RangeError();if(!xs.length)return [];const n=k%xs.length;return n?[...xs.slice(-n),...xs.slice(0,-n)]:[...xs];}

referenceTests.content: import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {rotate} from '../src/rotate.js';test('independent rotation contract',()=>{const xs=[1,2,3];assert.deepEqual(rotate(xs,1),[3,1,2]);assert.deepEqual(rotate(xs,4),[3,1,2]);assert.deepEqual(xs,[1,2,3]);assert.notEqual(rotate(xs,0),xs);assert.deepEqual(rotate([],2),[]);assert.throws(()=>rotate(null,1),TypeError);assert.throws(()=>rotate(xs,-1),RangeError);assert.throws(()=>rotate(xs,1.5),RangeError)});
